task: PRVR parameter/index/text-encoding census; no training or benchmark evaluation

definitions.unique_parameters: unique nn.Parameter objects; tied aliases counted once; buffers excluded; frozen parameters included in total
definitions.training_total: all registered model parameters; trainable is requires_grad=True, without calling backward
definitions.inference: union of parameter tensors accessed by operations during author encode_context plus get_pred_from_raw_query, eval/no_grad, synthetic inputs only; forward hooks enumerate modules; includes author-executed intermediate computations even if later discarded
definitions.index: author cached output positions; padded frame slots and valid frame counts reported separately; query-conditioned slots and auxiliary-token inputs are not video-index entries
definitions.text_encoding_calls: one PRVR query-encoding invocation per independent member; offline pretrained feature extractors excluded; internal subencoders remain part of that invocation
